summary: Implements Terrain as a rules-engine primitive (issue #135): a Terrain-keyword Strategy plays via PlayStrategy as a Battle action with no target, capped at one Terrain per battlefield, landing in Zone.Battlefield instead of discarding. FinishBattleResolution discards it after battle effects apply. New terrain-at-battle target category lets a Battle ability target it. Client rendering needed no changes (Army/board rendering already has no Personality-type filter). Shared-file note: docs/ROADMAP.md is touched only to move the Terrain row from Not-started to the primitives table documenting this same rules change -- no unrelated doc edits, no client code touched, everything else is core engine.
validation: New TerrainPrimitive test covers play, one-per-battlefield block, destroy via ability, replay after clearing, and auto-discard at resolution. Full suite 86/86+34/34+8/8 pass. tools/check.sh --skip-client passes.
remaining: Training fixtures only, no published card yet. Client visual placement verified by code reading only. Open PR 92 overlaps these files but appears based on a stale branch point; ordinary merge-conflict resolution applies when it lands.
